items.title: Christopher "Happy" Goldston Interview, 1962-04-11
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Does that look like that's the end of it, Molly?

ctx.x: I don't know, but I know my name wasn't there. I will impress the people. Mm-hmm. All right.

Does that look like that's the end of it, Molly? Just about. Yeah, well, we better call it to a halt, because I know it's getting late in the day. We sure do thank you for doing this. We really appreciate it. Thank you.
